title: coord.py claims, leases and compare-and-swap on a local SQLite store, usable by any agent
goal: python3 _tools/coord.py, standard library only, keeps a SQLite store (one file, path from --store or KB_COORD_STORE) with subcommands that print JSON: claim KEY --ttl SECONDS [--holder NAME] (create-if-absent, printing the key, its holder and the holder's token, so a second claim of a live key fails with exit 1 and names the holder), renew KEY --token T (extends only the holder's lease), release KEY --token T, get KEY, put KEY --value V --revision N (writes only when the key is still at revision N, an absent key being at revision 0, else exit 1) and list --prefix P; an expired lease counts as absent, and every write runs in one SQLite transaction so two processes racing on one key cannot both win.

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time,concurrent.futures as F
T="_tools/coord.py"
if not os.path.isfile(T):print("coord.py missing: the work adds it");sys.exit(1)
E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),"coord.sqlite"))
def c(*a):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=60);return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
r1,o,_=c("claim","k1","--ttl","60","--holder","alice");j=json.loads(o);tok=j.get("token")
r2,o2,e2=c("claim","k1","--ttl","60","--holder","bob")
bad=c("renew","k1","--token","not-the-holder")[0];good=c("renew","k1","--token",str(tok))[0]
rel=c("release","k1","--token",str(tok))[0];again=c("claim","k1","--ttl","60")[0]
p0=c("put","v","--value","a","--revision","0")[0];p1=c("put","v","--value","b","--revision","0")[0]
got=json.loads(c("get","v")[1]).get("value")
c("claim","k2","--ttl","1");time.sleep(1.6);expired=c("claim","k2","--ttl","60")[0]
lst=c("list","--prefix","k")[1]
with F.ThreadPoolExecutor(8) as x:wins=sum(r[0]==0 for r in x.map(lambda _:c("claim","race","--ttl","60"),range(8)))
res=dict(claim=r1==0 and bool(tok),second_refused=r2==1,holder_named="alice" in o2+e2,renew_other_refused=bad!=0,renew_holder=good==0,
 release_frees=rel==0 and again==0,cas=p0==0 and p1==1 and got=="a",expired_absent=expired==0,
 list_prefix="k1" in lst and "k2" in lst and "\"v\"" not in lst,one_race_winner=wins==1)
print(res);sys.exit(0 if all(res.values()) else 1)

gates.question: With neither --store nor KB_COORD_STORE, and no --holder, what does coord.py do?
options: refuse with exit 2 and default the holder to anonymous
default the store to a file under _cache/ and the holder to the user name
gates.recommendation: refuse with exit 2 and default the holder to anonymous
gates.answer: refuse with exit 2 and default the holder to anonymous

gates.question: How do claim leases and put values share a key, and what do get and a wrong-token renew do?
options: one row per key: a claim starts at revision 1 with a lease, put writes the value and raises the revision on a leased or plain key, a lease that expired drops the whole row, get of an absent key exits 1, a refused command prints a JSON body with the reason
separate tables for leases and values, so a key can hold both independently
gates.recommendation: one row per key: a claim starts at revision 1 with a lease, put writes the value and raises the revision on a leased or plain key, a lease that expired drops the whole row, get of an absent key exits 1, a refused command prints a JSON body with the reason
gates.answer: one row per key: a claim starts at revision 1 with a lease, put writes the value and raises the revision on a leased or plain key, a lease that expired drops the whole row, get of an absent key exits 1, a refused command prints a JSON body with the reason
